static_traits.name: Jiang Chuan
static_traits.family_status: Father is a Mechanic; family expects the client to become a Mechanic, arguments easily arise when discussing career choices with Father
static_traits.social_status: Has a few supportive friends, but not yet discussing family pressure with them due to embarrassment; communication with Father blocked, Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: No prior psychotherapy experience; no obvious major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly state distress and specific situations; often using absolutist and catastrophic expressions (e.g., 'I can only ever be a Mechanic''like unable to breathe'); easily defensive and angry when communicating with Father; feeling shame and avoidance about seeking support; cooperation fair

basic_info.main_problem: I feel limited by my family (especially Father) expecting me to become a Mechanic, which makes me Anxious with a feeling of being trapped. After deciding to go to college in three months, this feeling intensified, especially when discussing future career plans.
basic_info.core_demands: When family expectations began affecting my mental health and decisions about the future, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: After deciding to go to college in three months, the family (especially Father) more explicitly expects me to follow his path to become a Mechanic, which significantly raised my pressure when discussing future careers and plans, intensifying Anxiety and the feeling of being trapped.

Last week when discussing future careers with Father, he asked which repair shops I would apply to after leaving Walmart, almost ignoring my interest in graphic design projects and insisting on the Mechanic path; I felt very small, angry and defensive, but more defeated and unseen.

core_beliefs: I can only ever be a Mechanic
If I do not follow Father's path, I will fail and disappoint my family

special_situations.event: When discussing future career plans with Father, Father ignored the client's interest in graphic design and insisted on the Mechanic path
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not become a Mechanic, it means I am not as good as Father and will disappoint my family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becoming angry and defensive, reducing communication with father to avoid conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My dreams do not matter; I will disappoint my family

special_situations.event: Exploring different career options online (e.g., graphic design)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Other paths besides becoming a Mechanic will all fail, ultimately proving I cannot do it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Halting exploration and Self-denial, believing continued exploration is a waste of time
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I choose graphic design, I will fail and end up back at Walmart

special_situations.event: Approaching the date of leaving for college, family expectations of the Mechanic path being constantly mentioned
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I take a different path, I will not be supported and recognized by my family
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding seeking support from friends to avoid the risk of 'being looked down on'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot choose another path, otherwise I will not be recognized

special_situations.event: Thinking about future career choices and family expectations at Work, declining attention and ability to relax
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failing to meet family expectations equals failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly worrying about the future, struggling to focus on current tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am trapped, I even feel I can barely breathe

core_conflict.wish: Longing for the Freedom of independent choice, and still being understood and accepted by family when choosing a different path
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure if not following Father's path, being negated and rejected by family, unable to 'meet the standard'
defense_goal: Reduces external conflict and internal shame by avoiding sharing and responding defensively

object_relations.self_representation: Small, negated child (worrying about not being as good as Father, being unseen)
object_relations.object_representation: A strong, dismissive expecter (Father represented as someone who only recognizes the Mechanic path)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to share stress with friends or seek social support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes friends will look down on them (attributing shame and negation to others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tending to avoid sharing, using a vague and reserved tone, emphasizing 'They will not understand me', to end the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When trying to explore non-Mechanic career options online
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Viewing family non-support as evidence that exploration is utterly meaningless, thus providing justification for Withdrawal
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Wrapping up with the logic 'since the family will not support, continuing to explore is a waste of time', shortening the discussion and stopping action.

manifestations: Feels restricted and trapped between family expectations and self-choices
The Freedom issue becoming more prominent after deciding to go to college, Anxiety rising when discussing the future
outcomes: Significant Anxiety and feeling of being trapped
Decline in work concentration, Difficulty relaxing during leisure

manifestations: Not sharing pressure with friends due to embarrassment, worrying about being looked down upon
Lacks practical support and emotional resonance in important decisions

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Self-emphasizes 'this should be something I handle myself'
Taking family standards as the only success path (Mechanic), struggling to digest own interests and diverse possibilities

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavioral impulses toward others or the outside world, turning the energy toward oneself, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not seeking support from friends, choosing to bear pressure and shame alone
Turning to self-depletion when external resources are needed (Anxiety cycle, stopping exploration)

exception_events.target_problem: When facing family expectations to become a Mechanic and discussing future career choices, the client usually feels trapped and Anxious, and tends toward Withdrawal or stopping exploration.
exception_events.unique_outcome: The client decided to go to college in three months and began checking project information on different career paths like graphic design; unlike previously just complying with expectations, this time proactively made a choice inconsistent with the family path, initially feeling excited too.
exception_events.reason: Cues: because they saw the possibilities and hope brought by concrete graphic design projects and university choices, intrinsic motivation increased, so even in high-pressure situations they still took the action of proactive exploration.

positive_force: Has clearly decided to go to university, with motivation and action to explore outward
Able to identify and express specific negative automatic thoughts, creating conditions for cognitive Intervention
Has some foundation of social support (supportive friends)
Willing to seek professional help and accept cognitive strategies such as 'reality testing'
negative_force: Strong family expectations and comparison pressure, fearing not being as good as Father
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, and mind reading (predicting family and friends' negative views)
Shame and Self-monitoring leading to unwillingness to seek support, avoiding sharing
Frequent communication conflicts with Father, causing Emotional exhaustion and Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety arising when with Father or discussing future careers, becoming defensive/quarrelsome
antecedent: Discussing career plans with Father or being pushed toward the Mechanic path
Approaching the school departure date, when discussing future plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized family expectations and failure Fear (worrying about not being as good as Father, disappointing the family) leading to high threat evaluation of different paths
target_behavior.function: Escaping negation and relationship conflict, reducing the subjective intensity of shame and Anxiety short-term
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension with Father, conflict escalating; Anxiety maintained or worsening, career decision stalled

target_behavior.behavior: Self-denial and stopping action when exploring non-Mechanic careers online (believing it a waste of time)
antecedent: Opening and viewing information on different careers like graphic design
Thinking the family may not support
target_behavior.core_reason: Cognitive biases of catastrophizing and predicting the future (certain of failure, certain of no support)
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and the risk of being negated, gaining short-term emotional 'control'
target_behavior.consequence: Career exploration interrupted, narrowed range of choices, falling into trappedness and helplessness
